headline: Hungary accelerates its path to the euro: record budget surplus in July, after the deficit had exploded to 3,850 billion forints in the first four months
summary: Hungary recorded its largest monthly budget surplus in the history of available data, at 524.3 billion forints in July. The surplus follows a deficit of 3,850 billion forints in the first four months.
why: Budget balances shape a country's debt trajectory and its readiness to meet euro-adoption criteria, which matter for the forint and Hungarian government bonds.
